title: the launcher's help lists what bin_shortcuts lists
intention: `cairn help` and `cairn <device> help` list exactly what the base shim's bin_shortcuts lists, the bin beside a device's code included: the launcher's help keeps no instance-bin guard of its own, and a device with shortcuts in either bin gets a section.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: bin/cairn _help guards on the instance bin's folder (`if not b.is_dir(): print('  (no bin under ...)')`) and builds the `cairn help` roster from instance bins alone, so a device whose shortcuts live beside its code, as 5.4.3.3 puts them, shows `(no bin under ...)` or no section, though bin_shortcuts (ba777080011b) lists them.
traces_to: Outline 5.4.3.3 (a device's bin/ beside its code IS its list of shortcuts), 2.4.11.1 (help is readable cold), 8.4 / Q#27 (the help order); RULE 1 and Law 1: bin/cairn says it holds no copy of the bin-reading rule, and its instance-bin guard is one.
how: In bin/cairn _help: pass CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT="$CLASS_ROOT" to the python; shortcuts(dev, n) prints bin_shortcuts(dev, root, n) or `  (none)`, with no folder check; the roster after operator and cairn is every device with an instance bin or a bin beside its code, alpha order. Red-first proof over a scratch instance root and a scratch class root.

clauses.claim: over a scratch instance root holding fxhc/0 with no bin and a scratch class root (CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT) holding an executable fxhc/bin/wave whose comment is `wave — waves`, `cairn help` exits 0 and has an [fxhc] section whose lines include `wave — waves`, and no line contains `no bin under`
in the same world `cairn fxhc help` exits 0 and its text includes `wave — waves`
a device whose instance bin holds nothing executable and that has no bin beside its code still gets its section, which reads `(none)`
the standing launcher proofs pass unchanged: bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py, bin/proofs/test_the_launcher_reads_the_bin_beside_the_code.py

decisions.text: D1: bin/cairn _help: the python's environment gains CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT="$CLASS_ROOT" beside CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT. Inside it, cls = Path(os.environ['CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT']); shortcuts(dev, n=0) prints each row of bin_shortcuts(dev, str(root), n, class_root=str(cls)) as before, or `  (none)` when it returns no row, and no longer checks any folder. In mode all, rest = sorted names d of the folders under root where (root/d/'0'/'bin').is_dir(), union the folders under cls where (cls/d/'bin').is_dir(); then operator, cairn, and rest minus those two, as now. The header comment's 'THIS FILE HOLDS NO COPY' sentence stays true and cites ba777080011b.

D2: the proof bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES {'211facd306d7': {'1': 'help_lists_a_class_only_device', '2': 'device_help_lists_the_class_bin', '3': 'an_empty_device_reads_none', '4': 'the_standing_launcher_proofs_pass'}}}}. World and env as bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py builds them (scratch HOME from the scratch door, CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT, CAIRN_VENV a missing folder, CAIRN_PG_SOCKET_DIR an empty folder) plus CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT=<scratch>/classes holding fxhc/bin/wave; fxhd/0/bin holds one non-executable file for clause 3. Tooth 4 runs the two proofs as subprocesses and asserts exit 0.

measured.saw: the launcher's help checks the instance bin's folder before calling bin_shortcuts and builds its roster from instance bins only
